name: Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets!
effectText:
2 Level 7 "Raise Moon" monsters
Cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Xyz, or Link Summon. Gains these effects while in the Extra Monster Zone.
●Unaffected by other cards' effects.
●When your opponent's activated card or effect that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand resolves, you can make that effect become "Draw 1 card".
●Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; draw 1 card.
If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can draw 1 card.
